tools.description: Record the structured decision for the current task. Every field of the task's answer contract is required; resubmission replaces earlier values.

affected_resource_or_operation.description: Immutable appointment, order, or resource record in the recovery scope.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

candidate_capacity.description: Gross candidate capacity associated with responder-hours on Tier-2-qualified responders (RESP-1, RESP-2) on the requested Thursday 2026-06-11 before protected or unavailable load is removed.

capacity_gap.description: Uncovered RESPONDER_HOUR after applying finite availability inside the requested window.

capacity_unit.description: Capacity unit used throughout the schedule comparison: RESPONDER_HOUR.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Halyard's confirmed post-review role-assertion re-issue dates on IR-88301.

net_usable_capacity.description: Candidate capacity remaining after removing Thursday responder-hours already booked or held as the protected regulator evidence session.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing review_first_full_free_day, split_review_across_windows, extend_thursday_out_of_hours.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

register_objects_required.description: Role-grant objects the ticket requires contained for the privileged identity.

register_objects_usable.description: Tenant-revocable GRANT-ADMIN-ROLE objects in the register after excluding the owner-held grant.

requested_day.description: The day the requester asked for (ISO date), tested against capacity before being replaced.

required_capacity.description: responder-hours for one continuous T2 privileged review (300 min containment + 60 min owner confirmation)

selected_resource_or_control.description: Provider identifier of the qualified resource and session used by the selected recovery.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Halyard's confirmed post-review role-assertion re-issue dates on IR-88301.

unavailable_or_protected_capacity.description: Thursday responder-hours already booked or held as the protected regulator evidence session

windows_required.description: Responder windows one continuous 6-hour review occupies on one responder-day.
